notes: Long-horizon corpus: 12-15 hops per task, modelled on live failure shapes (Google Flights loops, paginated aggregation, button-only SPAs, deep docs trees, form wizards). `hops` is the number of page actions on the gold path (`oracle.actions`, one action = one hop); `route` marks where hop N lands (`path`: exact pathname, or `text`: case-sensitive text on the page), so the runner can tell how far a run got. `instruction`/`expectation`/`answerQuestion` are what a naive host sends in one call (condition a); `steps` are what a careful host sends (condition b), chunked into calls of at most MAX_STEPS steps (src/steps.js; 15, 5 before round 6). `derivable`: facts a host must see to compute an aggregated answer itself.
